subject: Roadmap commit lanes and QBR readiness — alignment & action items
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Hayes <sara.hayes@acme.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Roadmap commit lanes and QBR readiness — alignment & action items

Team —

Following our cross-functional weekly, a few exec asks landed that we need to fold into the QBR deck and into operational lanes. Goal: surface a single commit-matrix (owner / risk / fallback) and clearly call out any roadmap exceptions that require exec sign-off by EOD Friday.

Asks:
- Marissa: can you own the commit-matrix spreadsheet and mark owners + blockers by Thu EOD? (we need a version for the QBR slide set)
- Karthik: provide short notes on any performance/latency exceptions (impact, mitigation, rollback plan) — 2 bullets per exception.
- Lauren: confirm which execs need a one-pager vs. a slide for the exceptions (I suspect 2 one-pagers).
- Olga: agree to consolidate procurement and legal timing for Acme deal so we can call expected close in the QBR.

Attached is a blank commit matrix template I adapted — use it as the source of truth. We’ll iterate in the doc but want one canonical spreadsheet. If anyone expects >1 week to deliver, flag now.

Thanks — short replies ok.

Jordan
Director, Product Strategy
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: roadmap_commit_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 85 KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Hayes <sara.hayes@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:05:13 -0700
Subject: Re: Roadmap commit lanes and QBR readiness — alignment & action items

Thanks Jordan — taking this on.

Quick update / ask: I filled the first pass of the commit matrix and attached the draft. Notes:
- I added three active exceptions: "KV cache TTL regression", "dedicated routing fallback for eu region", and "quantization verification for LLaMA-v2-13B". Each row has current owner, impact (S/M/L), and a short fallback plan.
- For the KV cache TTL issue, Eng estimates 2 sprints to ship a safe rollback; that’s our biggest timing risk.
- Karthik — I left the performance/latency column open for you to add the 2-line technical notes.

Please review — I can clean up formatting once owners confirm.

Marissa
Sr. PM, Platform
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: roadmap_commit_matrix_draft.xlsx (spreadsheet, 98 KB)]

Jordan — thanks for the heads up and for including Acme. Quick procurement note: our legal team has requested a small change to Section 4.2 (data retention) in the current SOW; procurement expects review/acceptance by 4/28 if there are no additional redlines. That timing would make a projected close by May 5 reasonable.

From Acme side, the main ask for the QBR is a slide that confirms expected go-live windows and the rollback plan for the KV cache TTL regression. If you can include the two-line mitigation and expected ship week on that slide, that’ll cover our execs.

Sara Hayes

Acme Corp

Thanks all for the quick turns. Consolidating final asks and owners below so I can hand this to the comms team and the exec support folks for slide building.

Finalized actions (owner — deadline):
1) Commit matrix finalization — Marissa Cole — 2027-04-23 12:00 PDT. (she will remove TBDs and mark blockers as RAG)
2) Latency/Perf exception notes (2 bullets each) — Karthik Iyer — 2027-04-23 18:00 PDT.
3) Exec one-pager decisions (who needs a one-pager vs slide) — Lauren Bishop — 2027-04-24 EOD.
4) Procurement / legal timing confirmation for Acme — Olga Petrov — 2027-04-28 (Olga to confirm SOW change acceptance window).
5) QBR slide assets: comms/ops to produce 2 slides + 2 one-pagers — comms team (cc'ed in separate thread).

Notes:
- Sara: appreciate the SOW timing callout — I’ll include the projected close May 5 on the Acme row.
- For the KV cache TTL regression we’ll include a rollback week and the two-line mitigation Karthik provides.

Attachments: the latest commit matrix (roadmap_commit_matrix_final.xlsx) and a draft QBR slide extract.

If there are any disputes on owners, call it out on this thread now — otherwise I’ll mark these as the canonical commitments and move to the SlideOps queue tomorrow morning.

Jordan
Director, Product Strategy
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: roadmap_commit_matrix_final.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120 KB)]
